items.title: CFTC asks Novig and ProphetX to hold off listing sports micro and scorigami contracts, CryptoWeek reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC asks Novig and ProphetX to hold off listing sports micro and scorigami contracts, CryptoWeek reports** — CryptoWeek reports the CFTC sent letters asking Novig and ProphetX not to list self-certified sports contracts and to explain why they comply with federal commodities law, with neither set yet listed for trading. Novig's micro contracts, such as which player scores the first points in a basketball game, were flagged as susceptible to manipulation, while ProphetX's scorigami contracts, which pay out on a final score never seen before in the sport, were said not to meet the Commodity Exchange Act definition of a swap, and ProphetX said it deferred listing and sent staff further analysis. ([CryptoWeek](https://cryptoweek.ai/news/cftc-asks-novig-and-prophetx-to-hold-off-listing-sports-micro-and-scorigami-contracts-questioning-whether-federal-law-allows-them))

items.content_text: - **Predict.fun suspected exploit drains about 300,000 dollars through Relay bridge to Tornado Cash, Coinotag reports** — Onchain Lens flagged Predict.fun, a prediction market on BNB Chain, as likely exploited on October 27, tracing about 300,000 dollars in outflows from Kernel-tagged contracts through relay wallets and the Relay bridge into Tornado Cash. items.title: Polymarket August rule change cut Bitcoin last-10-second trading to 3.02 percent in five-minute contracts, Coinotag reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket August rule change cut Bitcoin last-10-second trading to 3.02 percent in five-minute contracts, Coinotag reports** — Research into Polymarket five-minute Bitcoin contracts suggests an August change to settlement rules, using a time-weighted average price for payout, reduced trading bunched in the final ten seconds to 3.02 percent of volume. That compares with a 3.05 percent pre-contract baseline, and the research leaves open whether the earlier late-trading strategy stayed profitable after costs.
